name: L-V-Eval
intro: LV-Eval 是包含 11 个中英双语单跳与多跳问答数据集的长上下文基准。1,729 个独特问答对在 16K、32K、64K、128K 和 256K 五个长度层级上构成 8,645 个上下文，并用混淆事实、关键词替换和关键词召回指标减轻知识泄漏与评分偏差。
org: Infinigence AI, Tsinghua University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
build_method: 混合, 人工标注, 大模型生成
metric: 关键词召回门控 F1, ROUGE-L
task_type: 单跳问答, 多跳问答
eval_feature: 16K–256K 可控长度, 混淆事实, 知识泄漏缓解
scale: 8,645 个上下文 / 1,729 个独特问答对 / 11 个数据集
eval_feature_en: Controlled 16K–256K lengths, confusing facts, leakage mitigation
intro_en: LV-Eval is a long-context benchmark of 11 bilingual single-hop and multi-hop QA datasets. Its 1,729 unique QA pairs are materialized at 16K, 32K, 64K, 128K, and 256K into 8,645 contexts, with confusing facts, keyword replacement, and keyword-recall scoring designed to reduce knowledge leakage and metric bias.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2402.05136v3 Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix B plus official LVEval repository snapshot 63e7ae9. The diagram preserves 11 bilingual datasets, 1,729 unique QA pairs, five 16K–256K word-or-Chinese-character levels, and 8,645 resulting contexts. Supporting and distractor documents are sampled to the target length, shuffled, and multi-hop supports dispersed. Six datasets receive GPT-4-generated similar facts that humans revise to create genuine conflicts; six receive 1,924 manually designed keyword and phrase replacements. Five full-time master's-level annotators review 557 confusing-fact instances and 955 answer-keyword instances. Evaluation uses greedy decoding, head-tail middle truncation when required, a keyword-recall gate, blacklist-aware F1, and the original task metric such as ROUGE-L where specified.
